_comment: Base costs ONLY — tunable data. The formulas that consume these (linear vs quadratic, and the resource free-floating premium) live in code in default-price-list.js. Edit the numbers here; do not add logic.
_actorModelNote: actorModel = the legacy actor-attached cost model (design §6–§8), consumed by configurator/cost-model.js. It deliberately DIVERGES from the price-list groups above until P1.4 unifies pricing — values must stay identical to their pre-migration literals. Formulas (quadratic regen, Σ(base + coeff·(n-1)²) stacks) stay in code.
_actionBudgetNote: Runtime action costs charged against core's per-run budget ledger (NOT the authoring price list). core-ts enforces caps and emits limit events; these numbers are the Allocator's policy, injected via ports/budget.js. action_default applies to every action kind; specific kinds override it.
_motivationFallbackNote: motivationFallback = DEFAULT_MOTIVATION_COSTS tier prices (design §6.6) used when a price map lacks motivation entries. These are the numbers behind the pinned silent-overcharge bug; P1.4 eliminates the fallback entirely.
_levelAuthoringNote: Level-authoring economy knobs, moved out of commands/card-authoring.js by CR.1 — they were pricing policy sitting in glue, feeding calculateCardValue, card receipts, UI guidance and auto-generation. budget_split_percent must sum to 100. The reference budget is NOT here: it is REFERENCE_BUDGET_TOKENS in budget-allocation.js, which card-authoring duplicated as DEFAULT_LEVEL_BUDGET_TOKENS (both 2500) until CR.1 collapsed them.
_levelBudgetSplitNote: Per-card-type share of a level budget, as percentages summing to 100. Its own group because the base-cost standard requires every item to be a NUMBER — a nested object here would be formula selection in JSON, which the standard puts in code.
